spans.s: अप्तोर्याम m. The name of the last or seventh part of the Jyotiṣṭoma sacrifice.
आप्त (I) a. (f. प्ता) 1. Gained, obtained; 2. trusted, confidential; 3. true; 4. reasonable, sensible.
आप्त (II) m. 1. A friend, a credible person (आप्तस्तु यथार्थवक्ता); 2. a relative, निग्रहास्त्वसुराप्तानां वधाच्च धनदानुजः R.xii.52.
आप्त (III) n. 1. A quotient (in math.); 2. an equation of a degree (in math.).
आप्त (I) a. (f. प्ता) 1. Gained, obtained; 2. trusted, confidential; 3. true; 4. reasonable, sensible.
आप्त-काम (I) a. 1. one who has obtained his desire; 2. one who has given up all worldly desires.
आप्त-गर्भा f. a woman in pregnancy.
आप्त-वाच् (I) a. one whose word is credible and authoritative, पराभिसन्धानमधीयते यैर्विद्येति ते सन्ति किलाप्तवाचः Sak.v.
आप्त-वाच् (II) f. 1. the advice of a friend; 2. authoritative word (Śruti and Smṛti are considered such authoritative evidence), आप्तवागनुमानाभ्यां साध्यं त्वां प्रति का कथा R.x.28.
आप्ति f. 1. Acquisition, gain; 2. reaching; 3. fitness, propriety; 4. completion.
